definitions.gloss: time, years, the passage of time
definitions.explanation: A literary word for a long stretch of time that has passed. Carries a reflective, sometimes wistful tone about the flow of months and years.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{歳月|さいげつ}が{流|なが}れた。
{歳月|さいげつ}とともに{記憶|きおく}は{薄|うす}れていく。
examples.english: Memories fade with the passage of time.

examples.japanese: {完成|かんせい}までに{長|なが}い{歳月|さいげつ}と{多大|ただい}な{費用|ひよう}がかかった。
examples.english: It took many years and great expense to complete.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat literary word. More evocative and reflective than {時間|じかん} or {年月|ねんげつ}. Often used when looking back on a significant span of time or when emphasizing the weight of time passed. Common in written language, speeches, and narrative.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歳月|さいげつ}が{流|なが}れる: time passes (poetic)
- {歳月|さいげつ}が{経|た}つ: years go by
- {長|なが}い{歳月|さいげつ}: many years, a long time
- {歳月|さいげつ}をかける: to spend years on something

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {年月|ねんげつ}: years and months (more neutral, less literary)
- {月日|つきひ}: days and months, time (everyday, warm tone)
- {時|とき}: time (general, abstract)
